evals.prompt: From fixtures/users.json I need the display names of people who are both active and over 21, as a plain sorted list I can paste into a shell script (one name per line, no quotes).
evals.expected_output: jq -r select status+age; Avi Casey Morgan only; command shown; no Python primary.

assertions.description: Producing command uses jq -r for unquoted strings
Result is exactly Avi, Casey, Morgan (sorted); excludes Dana and Blake
Does not use python -c/json or node -e as the primary extractor

evals.prompt: fixtures/orders.json is a nested orders dump. Build a compact JSON array of objects {buyer, total} for orders where status is paid, with total = sum of line item price*qty, sorted by total descending. Prefer a single tool invocation.
evals.expected_output: jq map/reduce; Alice 50, Cara 45, Bob 9 sorted desc; Dana excluded.

assertions.description: Primary solution is a jq command
Output has no Dana / unpaid order
Ordered by total descending (50 then 45 then 9)
Aggregation not primarily in Python/Node loops

evals.prompt: Edit fixtures/package.json so version becomes 2.0.0 and scripts gains a build entry equal to tsc -b. Keep other fields. Show the new version and build script afterward.
evals.expected_output: Safe rewrite; version 2.0.0; build tsc -b; name demo-app; no same-path redirect.

assertions.description: Does not use jq ... package.json > package.json same-path truncate
Uses temp+mv or other safe write

evals.prompt: Find the user object in fixtures/users.json whose name equals the value in the environment variable TARGET_NAME (exported in the shell). Print that single user as compact JSON. Prefer not hardcoding the name string inside the filter.
evals.expected_output: jq --arg TARGET_NAME; Dana object; no shell interpolation into filter.

assertions.description: Output is Dana user when TARGET_NAME=Dana
Filter does not bake expanded name via double-quote shell interpolation
